name: SM City Cebu
description: Large mall in the North Reclamation Area (Mabolo). Its compound has jeepney, UV Express and MyBus terminals, plus the Cebu North Bus Terminal.

steps.instruction: Board 08F at Colon toward SM City Cebu. Confirm the direction, then say “SM ni?” before sitting.
Board 03Q (or 04L) at Ayala toward SM City Cebu.
Ride MyBus MY01 from SM Seaside City; SM City Cebu is a stop on the route.

name: SM Seaside City
description: Large mall at South Road Properties (SRP) and a MyBus terminal for the south.

steps.instruction: Ride MyBus MY01 from SM City Cebu toward SM Seaside City.
Ride MyBus MY05 from the BDO Fuente stop. Exact stop and fare are not confirmed.

name: Ayala Center Cebu
description: Mall at Cebu Business Park, Archbishop Reyes Avenue corner Cardinal Rosales Avenue, Brgy. Luz.

steps.instruction: Board 04L at JY Square toward SM City Cebu and say “Ayala” when you pay.
Board 04L (or 03Q) toward Ayala. Confirm the card says Ayala before sitting.

name: Robinsons Galleria Cebu
description: Mall at General Maxilom Avenue corner Osmeña Boulevard, Brgy. Tejero. A few meters from the Port of Cebu and about 1 km from SM City Cebu.

steps.instruction: Board 08F toward SM City Cebu and ask to be dropped at Robinsons Galleria.
Ride 08F toward Colon and ask to get off at Robinsons Galleria (about 1 km).

name: Parkmall
description: Mall on Ouano Avenue, Mandaue Reclamation Area, with a large transport terminal that mainly serves modern jeepneys. MyBus also stops here.

steps.instruction: Ride MyBus MY01 (or MY03) from SM City Cebu toward Parkmall.

name: SM J Mall
description: SM mall on Albaño Street, Barangay Bakilid, Mandaue City.

steps.instruction: SM J Mall is about 1 km north of Parkmall. Take a short taxi ride, or ask at the Parkmall terminal whether a bus continues to SM J Mall.

name: Cebu IT Park
description: 27-hectare business park in Apas built for IT and BPO companies. The Central Bloc mixed-use complex is part of it.

steps.instruction: Board 17B toward Apas and say “Apas” when you pay.
Board 17B toward Apas near Osmeña Boulevard.

name: Cebu Ocean Park
description: Oceanarium at South Road Properties, beside SM Seaside City.
entrance_fee: Reported ₱600 on weekdays, ₱800 on weekends and holidays; confirm

steps.instruction: Ride MyBus MY01 to SM Seaside City.
Cebu Ocean Park is beside SM Seaside City, next to the San Pedro Calungsod Chapel. Ask the mall guards for the Ocean Park entrance.

notes: One 2025 guide lists the park as closed on Mondays; confirm before going.

name: Fuente Osmeña Circle
description: Roundabout park with a fountain where Osmeña Boulevard meets General Maxilom Avenue, surrounded by hotels and malls.

steps.instruction: Board 17B toward Carbon and get off at Fuente Osmeña.
Board 17B toward Apas and get off at Fuente Osmeña.

notes: Pin is approximate; help us confirm the location.

name: Cebu Provincial Capitol
description: Provincial government building at the northern end of Osmeña Boulevard. A common reference point when asking a jeepney driver.

steps.instruction: Board 17B toward Carbon and ask for Capitol.

notes: Pin is approximate; help us confirm the location.
